```{r normalization}

# Compressed reference grid
ref_grid_size <- 100
ref_grid <- seq(0, 1000, length.out = ref_grid_size)
ref_grid_norm <- ref_grid / max(ref_grid)

interpolate_safe <- function(df, time_col = "time", id_col = "healthCode") {
  
  # Identify numeric columns (exclude time)
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric) & names(df) != time_col]
  
  subjects <- unique(df[[id_col]])
  
  # Pre-allocate result
  result <- data.frame(
    healthCode = rep(subjects, each = ref_grid_size),
    time_std  = rep(ref_grid, times = length(subjects))
  )
  
  # Initialize numeric columns
  for(col in numeric_cols) {
    result[[col]] <- NA
  }
  
  # Loop over subjects
  for(s in subjects) {
    df_sub <- df[df[[id_col]] == s, ]
    
    # Skip subjects with <2 time points
    if(length(unique(df_sub[[time_col]])) < 2) next
    
    # Normalize time
    time_norm <- (df_sub[[time_col]] - min(df_sub[[time_col]])) /
                 (max(df_sub[[time_col]]) - min(df_sub[[time_col]]))
    
    # Interpolate each numeric column
    for(col in numeric_cols) {
      vals <- df_sub[[col]]
      # Only interpolate if at least 2 non-NA values
      if(sum(!is.na(vals)) >= 2) {
        result[result[[id_col]] == s, col] <- approx(
          x = time_norm,
          y = vals,
          xout = ref_grid_norm,
          rule = 2
        )$y
      } else if(sum(!is.na(vals)) == 1) {
        # Only one value → repeat it
        result[result[[id_col]] == s, col] <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
      }
      # if all NA → leave as NA
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Apply function
neg_std <- interpolate_safe(neg)
pos_std <- interpolate_safe(pos)


```


```{r neg contours}

library(ggplot2)

plot_numeric_with_average <- function(df, id_col = "healthCode", time_col = "time_std") {
  
  # Identify numeric columns (excluding ID and time)
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric) & !names(df) %in% c(id_col, time_col)]
  
  if(length(numeric_cols) == 0) stop("No numeric columns to plot")
  
  # Convert to long format
  plot_data_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(numeric_cols),
                 names_to = "variable",
                 values_to = "value")
  
  # Compute average per time and variable
  avg_data <- plot_data_long %>%
    group_by(variable, .data[[time_col]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Generate ggplot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data_long, aes_string(x = time_col, y = "value", group = id_col)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.3, color = "blue") +                       # individual subjects
    geom_line(data = avg_data, aes_string(x = time_col, y = "mean_value", group = NULL),
              color = "red", size = 1.2) +                          # average
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Time", y = "Value",
         title = "Numeric Variables Over Time with Average") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p)  # automatically display plot
}

```

```{r display neg graph}

graph_n <- plot_numeric_with_average(neg_std)


```

```{r pos contours}

graph_p <- plot_numeric_with_average(pos_std)


```

```{r side by side comparison}

# Function to convert dataset to long format with group label
long_with_group <- function(df, group_name, id_col = "healthCode", time_col = "time_std") {
  
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric) & !names(df) %in% c(id_col, time_col)]
  
  df_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(numeric_cols),
                 names_to = "variable",
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(group = group_name)
  
  return(df_long)
}

# Convert both datasets to long format
neg_long <- long_with_group(neg_std, "neg")
pos_long <- long_with_group(pos_std, "pos")

# Combine both datasets
combined_long <- bind_rows(neg_long, pos_long)

# Compute averages per group, variable, and time
avg_data <- combined_long %>%
  group_by(group, variable, time_std) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Plot individual subjects + group averages
ggplot() +
  # Individual subjects
  geom_line(data = combined_long,
            aes(x = time_std, y = value, group = interaction(group, healthCode), color = group),
            alpha = 0.2) +
  # Group averages
  geom_line(data = avg_data,
            aes(x = time_std, y = mean_value, color = group),
            size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("neg" = "blue", "pos" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Value",
       title = "Negative vs Positive: Individual Subjects and Average Trajectories") +
  theme_minimal()

```
